description: Create an owned project catalog record, without publishing a graph or creating a repository. Compatibility name for map_project; prefer map_project when beginning a mapping. Returns the project ID and version.

displayName.description: Human-readable name for the project in the dashboard.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reuse the same key and identical payload only to retry the same mutation; use a new key for a new action.

projectType.description: Project classification used for the hosted mapping.

types.description: Type labels for the project, such as plugin or application. Use lowercase identifiers accepted by the schema.

name: create_project
